$comment: Corallum cutouts (tools/cutout.mjs; D46, D49, D50). Both series come from the 2025 portfolio sheets (pdf2025:p23, p24), cropped at 1:1, never upscaled. The eight volume diagrams and the three facade studies are shaded with pale grey fills (about 228/255) and orange lines, so they use the low floor/knee of rendered diagram panels and the inspection field in the dark scheme. The facade studies keep their numerals 1-3 (referred to in the caption); the printed text between each axonometric and its light diagram is erased from blank paper and re-set in the caption (D49). The level 01 plan, the western elevation and section A-A sit on rendered or screened grounds with no paper, so they are published as rectangles.
